title:
Create a 15-second vertical 9:16 text-only brand reel for D2 Media Communication.

STYLE:
Bold, playful, confident kinetic typography inspired by the attached reference image. Use oversized words that fill the screen, with some words intentionally cropped off the edges. Arrange typography at different angles, sizes and positions to create a dynamic editorial composition. Allow words to overlap, slide, rotate, scale and quickly rearrange between scenes. The overall feeling should be confident, unconventional, clever, energetic and premium — never corporate or generic.

Do NOT use photography, illustrations, icons, people, objects or imagery. Typography is the only visual element.

BRAND COLOURS:
Background: Indigo #0E0B20
Purple text: #AD00FF
Coral text: #FF0063

FONT:
Jost only. Use bold/heavy weights for maximum visual impact. Clean, modern, geometric and highly legible.

TEXT SEQUENCE:
0–2 sec:
“BOLD.”

2–4 sec:
“DIFFERENT.”

4–6 sec:
“SHARP.”

6–8 sec:
“FEARLESS.”

8–10 sec:
“UNMISSABLE.”

10–12 sec:
“RELIABLE.”

12–15 sec:
“D2 MEDIA”
followed by:
“MAKE YOUR MESSAGE MATTER.”

ANIMATION:
Start immediately with oversized typography entering rapidly from different directions. Words should move with purpose rather than simply fade in. Use quick slides, rotations, scaling and position changes. Introduce words one at a time, then briefly create moments where multiple words appear together in a playful typographic collage.

Alternate purple #AD00FF and coral #FF0063 for emphasis. Keep the indigo background consistently dominant.

Overall pacing: energetic, punchy and contemporary, with approximately 1–2 seconds per key word. Make the typography feel like it is taking over the screen.

No voiceover. No stock footage. No music-dependent storytelling. The reel must communicate entirely through typography and motion.

The finished reel should feel like a creative agency saying:
“We know who we are. We know what we do. And we’re not here to blend in.”

scenes.subtitle: In a world driven by artificial intelligence, a new challenge emerges: teaching machines to watch a video, truly understand it, and recreate something similar using nothing but code.
First, the system must watch the original video carefully, breaking it down frame by frame to grasp its motion, colors, pacing, and structure.
Next, the AI extracts patterns—identifying objects, transitions, and rhythm—turning raw visuals into structured data the code can understand.
With understanding complete, the code begins generating a new video—mirroring the style, tone, and energy of the original, frame by carefully written frame.
In the end, two videos play side by side—one original, one born from code—proof that machines can learn not just to see, but to create.

STYLE:
Bold, playful, confident kinetic typography inspired by the attached reference image. Use oversized words that fill the screen, with some words intentionally cropped off the edges. Arrange typography at different angles, sizes and positions to create a dynamic editorial composition. Allow words to overlap, slide, rotate, scale and quickly rearrange between scenes. The overall feeling should be confident, unconventional, clever, energetic and premium — never corporate or generic.

Do NOT use photography, illustrations, icons, people, objects or imagery. Typography is the only visual element.

BRAND COLOURS:
Background: Indigo #0E0B20
Purple text: #AD00FF
Coral text: #FF0063

FONT:
Jost only. Use bold/heavy weights for maximum visual impact. Clean, modern, geometric and highly legible.

TEXT SEQUENCE:
0–2 sec:
“BOLD.”

2–4 sec:
“DIFFERENT.”

4–6 sec:
“SHARP.”

6–8 sec:
“FEARLESS.”

8–10 sec:
“UNMISSABLE.”

10–12 sec:
“RELIABLE.”

12–15 sec:
“D2 MEDIA”
followed by:
“MAKE YOUR MESSAGE MATTER.”

ANIMATION:
Start immediately with oversized typography entering rapidly from different directions. Words should move with purpose rather than simply fade in. Use quick slides, rotations, scaling and position changes. Introduce words one at a time, then briefly create moments where multiple words appear together in a playful typographic collage.

Alternate purple #AD00FF and coral #FF0063 for emphasis. Keep the indigo background consistently dominant.

For the final 3 seconds, slow the movement slightly and create a strong visual payoff: “D2 MEDIA” should appear large and confident, followed by “MAKE YOUR MESSAGE MATTER.” Keep the final frame clean enough to read instantly.

Overall pacing: energetic, punchy and contemporary, with approximately 1–2 seconds per key word. Make the typography feel like it is taking over the screen.

No voiceover. No stock footage. No music-dependent storytelling. The reel must communicate entirely through typography and motion.

The finished reel should feel like a creative agency saying:
“We know who we are. We know what we do. And we’re not here to blend in.”
